version: v1.1 draft (house-style face, mass-first high ponytail, academy outfit, book stack held in the bind pose; v1.1 = the artist's v1 verdicts: side hairline lowered round the ear, continuous jaw cast-shadow field, shorter chin)
name_status: named by the sheet (LYRA - STUDENT RESEARCHER, PROFESSOR ELIAS' STUDENT)
units: metres; floor z = 0 at the soles

lip_seal.rule: front rays deeper than 2.5 mm behind the lip front = the gap; half the gap closed from each lip, falloff 9.0 mm, overlap 0.30 mm

eye_scale.shape_dev_rule: distance (mm) of each vertex after the scale to the unscaled (v2) surface; zones in the unscaled frame; 'outside_socket_core' = outer skin beyond the full-scale core

undereye.rule: front-ray profiles down 5 columns under each eye; depth = max sink behind the profile's front convex hull (mm)

fill.rule: per column under each lower lid: the skin -> the front convex hull of the lash-line point (0.25 mm under the lid edge) and the cheek (12.0 .. 24 mm under it); continued 4 mm past each lid corner, fading; vertices up to 2.5 mm behind the front move with it

relief_vs_fit_mm.rule: max |offset| of the lip-zone core's front surface from the per-column no-lip profile fit (proud lips and the seam crease alike)

eye_proof.rule: front rays on a 0.25 mm grid: iris-family hits / eyeball hits (the visible opening)

jaw_shadow.rule: cast placement (critical light elevation per vertex, head + neck occluder) -> per-azimuth terminator, Gaussian-smoothed (bin 4 deg, sigma 10 deg) = a drawn smooth edge

hidden_skin_removed.enclosed_rule: every vertex's rays toward 12 front / tactical directions hit body or eyeball within 8 cm
hidden_skin_removed.mouth_hidden_rule: mouth-zone faces facing backward or 0.05-3.0 mm behind the front skin

facing.rule: head centre (between the eyes, at the skull's mid depth) -> nose tip (midline)

face_zone.rule: body skin faces (skin, skin_shadow, lips, mouth, liner, brow, lash) with every vertex head- or neck_01-dominant

tier_rationale: HERO role: window [30000, 50000]. The MPFB body (face, hands) + the ribbon-lock ponytail hairdo + capelet + skirt panels + boots + the outfit pieces; the book stack as its own node.
open_edges_rule: every part is a closed solid (listed here only if not); the body is the MPFB skin

tuck_shade.rule: segment top faces -> hair_crevice when >= 0.60 of its 12 sample points lie under a lock layered above it (rays out along the section normal, within 12 mm); segments above 50 deg elevation (the lit crown) none

angel_ring.rule: v7: whole ribbon segments between the two stations placed where the spine crosses the ring elevations

cap_feather.rule: cap outer thickness x smoothstep(0, 0.045, height above the hairline), floor 0.0015 m

slivers.rule: faces under SLIVER_AREA collapse their shortest edge (3 passes)

bake.high_rule: MPFB body at subdivision 1 (smooth) + every part

high_lower_lid_rim_out.rule: lower-lid faces from 0.5 mm inside to 2.0 mm outside the lid edge, within 100 deg of straight down, tilted more than 50 deg from the view axis

normal_skin_only.rule: normal texels outside the (dilated) skin-region UV triangles set flat

hair_proxy_bake.strip: flat (0.5, 0.5, 1): the normal map carries nothing on hair

vertex_carrier.rule: hair faces (hair, hair_shade, hair_root, hair_ring, hair_tip, hair_inner, hair_crevice) smooth + custom split normals = the per-group proxy normal leaned 0.45 toward each part's own smooth normal; all other faces flat

hair_strip.rule: hair faces packed into u > 0.84; normal texels there flat, AO texels white
